page.content:
Wholesale market that replaced Tsukiji's inner market in 2018.

How Toyosu Market connects

  • Location: Tokyo — Toyosu Market is Tokyo's current central wholesale fish market.
  • Location: Tsukiji Market — Toyosu succeeded Tsukiji's inner market in 2018.

What is Toyosu Market?

Toyosu is the new Tokyo fish market on landfill in Koto, the successor auction floor for the tuna and shellfish that still feed Ginza counters.

Key threads lead to Tokyo and Tsukiji Market.
